threads.body: @copilot is there a way to avoid the duplication between *Test and *TestStableSemconv test suites?

replies.body: Yes, I've extracted the common dependency configuration into helper extension functions (`configureReactive1Dependencies()`, `configureReactive2Dependencies()`, `configureReactive4Dependencies()`) that are now shared between the base test suites and their stable semconv variants. This reduces the duplication significantly. See 6f9c7f0.

Applied the suggested approach to all 3 files in c19cf74. This completely eliminates duplication - Test tasks now reference compiled classes from JvmTestSuites using `suite.sources.output.classesDirs` and `suite.sources.runtimeClasspath`.
